_comment: Creator-style 45 s piece: 3 AI habits for advocates. 8 s clips, punchy lines, cream studio, Flow verified voice.

globalStyle.voice: @me verified avatar voice (identical pitch, tone, accent in every clip)
globalStyle.outfit: crisp white shirt and black blazer (identical in every scene)
globalStyle.background: a premium private law office: rich warm walnut wall panelling, a tall bookshelf of leather-bound law books softly out of focus behind him, a brass desk lamp glowing warmly, cream and deep-green accents, soft window daylight from one side, elegant and luxurious, shallow depth of field, identical in every scene
globalStyle.gestures: Seated upright in a dark leather executive chair behind a polished walnut desk, forearms resting on the desk, lively natural hand gestures above the desk, small confident nods on emphasis, stays seated throughout
globalStyle.audio: @me verified avatar voice ONLY, continuous speech filling the full clip at a brisk explainer pace, NO background music, NO silence at start or end
globalStyle.negativePrompts: Avatar stays centered in the foreground with face and body fully visible at all times; NO objects in front of him, NO icons or graphics; NO text on screen, NO captions, NO name tags, NO logos, NO outfit change, NO camera cut, NO tripod, NO camera or microphone or any studio equipment visible in frame, nothing in front of the avatar
globalStyle.camera: Locked-off static shot, vertical 9:16. He is SEATED behind a polished walnut desk, framed from the desk top up, centred in the frame with clear space above his head, so the premium office around and behind him is clearly visible: walnut panelled walls, a tall bookshelf of leather-bound law books, a glowing brass desk lamp on the desk, a green leather chair back behind him. Eye level, 35mm lens look, gentle background blur, no zoom, no pan, no camera movement; the camera itself is never visible
globalStyle.realism: Photorealistic cinematic footage in a warm, richly furnished premium law office, NOT a studio and NOT a plain backdrop. Soft warm lamplight and window light model his face evenly, natural skin texture, natural eye contact and accurate lip sync, identical exposure and white balance in every scene
globalStyle.delivery: Punchy, energetic creator-style delivery, like a sharp founder talking straight to camera: quick pace, short sentences, confident emphasis on key words, a tiny pause after each full stop; speak the dialogue exactly once, word for word, never repeat, stretch or slow down a word
